query: Please implement a big data city tourism display page to showcase city tourism information. The page should have functionalities for map display, data display, search, and filtering. Users should be able to browse city tourism information, view maps, search for specific information, and filter data. The page should also be able to update data in real-time, providing the latest tourism information. Implement pale green for the page background and forest green for the elements.
